method: Read RULES.md and TAXONOMY.md; atomscan slow scans, cleave facts and strings, Rizin call-site/TLS disassembly, full archive-member diff and independent registry/upstream acquisition through forager. Worker was decoded statically and exercised in JavaScriptCore with browser and Firebase APIs mocked; no live push service or sample PE was executed.

samples.identity: sass-embedded 1.83.4 x64-mingw-ucrt Ruby gem, embedding Dart Sass Windows AOT runtime and compiler snapshot
samples.provenance: forager RubyGems download of this exact native gem matches supplied SHA-256; generic platform PURL initially fetched the source gem, so comparison uses the separately fetched native x64-mingw-ucrt gem. All downloads and .forage.json records remain in scratch.
decisive_diff: dart.exe is byte-identical between 1.83.3 and 1.83.4: SHA-256 12b988cc2ec1390a011ce47f70d8d0082b5216d217f9cc27790fdc2214da911f.
Only the compiler snapshot and lib/sass/embedded/version.rb change within the gem data members; version changes from 1.83.3 to 1.83.4.

Both current dart.exe and sass.snapshot match the official dart-sass-1.83.4-windows-x64.zip from github.com/sass/dart-sass/releases/download/1.83.4/ byte for byte. Current snapshot SHA-256: 7daaf40e5aab4ade4537cc58635730d2ba2d7384a424d16d5ff4837d8fdb26ba.
execution_paths: Ruby Compiler::Connection invokes Open3.popen3 with the bundled compiler and --embedded, exchanging framed protocol messages on stdin/stdout. sass.bat passes sass.snapshot to dart.exe.
TLS callback 0x1401fe5d0 runs for DLL_THREAD_DETACH / DLL_PROCESS_DETACH, queries TlsGetValue and invokes registered thread-local destructors under locking.

TLS callback 0x1400a2b90 runs on DLL_THREAD_DETACH, initializes cleanup once, queries TLS state and calls registered destructors under SRW synchronization. Neither callback contains the imported debugger query or VirtualProtect call.

All IsDebuggerPresent IAT xrefs are at 0x14029dadc and 0x1402b554d in CRT exception-reporting routines, followed by SetUnhandledExceptionFilter and UnhandledExceptionFilter. The first builds STATUS_FATAL_APP_EXIT (0x40000015) state; debugger presence affects exception-reporting behavior.

VirtualProtect IAT xrefs at 0x140009840, 0x14023fa70 and 0x14027093c belong to native memory/image protection; the VM wrapper cites runtime/vm/virtual_memory_win.cc on failure. Their file-wide co-occurrence does not establish debugger-gated TLS execution.
samples.reason: Independent provenance, unchanged runtime and traced CRT/TLS behavior support an ordinary compiler release. The original anti-analysis placement and T1622/B0001 mapping inferred evasion without execution-path evidence.
samples.context_missing: No machine execution history, invoking application, administrator intent or host telemetry was supplied. No deployment circumstances are assumed.
samples.marker_line: Sass Embedded: unchanged Dart runtime; neutral TLS/import trait

samples.identity: wbcore 1.67.6 Django application framework with Firebase web/mobile notification backend
samples.provenance: forager fetch --all-wheels retrieved the original 1.67.6 wheel with the supplied SHA-256 and every original 1.67.5 wheel (one universal wheel for each version). Provenance retained alongside both wheels in scratch.
decisive_diff: All 1188 non-dist-info ZIP entries are byte-identical between 1.67.5 and 1.67.6, including service-worker.js.
The renamed dist-info METADATA differs only in Version; WHEEL is identical. RECORD changes to account for metadata paths and hashes.
execution_paths: The checksum-controlled rotation takes 21 left rotations and reaches checksum 0xb8813 (755731), restoring the actual property names and two Firebase 9.22.0 gstatic importScripts URLs.

The Uint8Array string contains ASCII Base64; TextDecoder then atob then JSON.parse reconstruct a Firebase public web-app configuration for workbench-stainly. That object is passed to firebase.initializeApp, not executed as code.
firebase.messaging(app).onBackgroundMessage reads notification title/body/endpoint/internal flag and passes them to self.registration.showNotification with a Stainly logo URL.

notificationclick closes the notification, finds a same-origin focusable window through clients.matchAll, posts HANDLE_NOTIFICATION with its endpoint and focuses it. Without a window it opens the external endpoint when the internal flag is false, or opens the endpoint origin with an encoded widget_endpoint parameter.

The Python Firebase backend sends exactly these title/body/endpoint/internal-flag data fields using configured service credentials and registered user notification tokens. The worker has no credential harvesting or remote code evaluation path.
samples.obfuscation: The existing suspicious JavaScript Obfuscator string-array runtime trait is correct and retained without suppression or severity change. Network script loading, message passing and Base64/URL codecs already have notable detections.
samples.reason: The full decoded behavior fits the supplied notification backend and the implementation is unchanged from the previous original wheel. Genuine obfuscation alone does not establish malicious intent.
samples.context_missing: No registration origin, deployed Firebase access rules, user notification consent state, actual push messages or machine execution history was supplied. Hardcoded public client configuration is not a stolen service-account credential.
samples.marker_line: wbcore: unchanged Firebase notification worker; keep obfuscation
